title: Every year holds less memory; 1904 on a phone: 516 MB
items: Buildings kept a second copy of every piece after drawing it. That copy is now freed, in every year.
The 1904 railway freed its leftover build lists too.
Phone memory at spawn: 1904 696 to 516 MB, 1835 582 to 490 MB, 1812 246 to 192 MB.
